title: Central African Republic calculator readiness research — Batch 42

findings.detail: FAO's 15 July 2026 brief reports central/southern 2026 maize planting completed under near-average planted area, with harvest expected from mid-August; northern millet/sorghum planting completed in early July. Flood risk was highlighted for Basse-Kotto, Mbomou and Ouaka.

World Bank RTFP catalogue provides an open monthly market-price dataset for 41 markets, 2007-01 through 2026-10, version 2026-10-05. Products include cassava, groundnuts, maize, beef, oil, rice, sesame and sorghum; geographic coverage is selected Admin 2 areas, not all prefectures.

World Bank dataset combines direct price observations with machine-learning estimates and identifies WFP/FAO as source organisations. Preserve method and source flags; these are market prices and are not automatically farm-gate prices.

ICASEES provides an official interactive map of 20 prefectures. A secondary cross-check describes seven regions: Plateaux, Équateur, Yadé, Kagas, Fertit, Haut-Oubangui and Bas-Oubangui, with 85 sub-prefectures.

Secondary FAOSTAT-sourced 2024 values for cassava, maize, rice and livestock remain leads only; retrieve matching FAOSTAT item-level harvested area, production, yield and source flags before activation.

sources.title: FAO GIEWS Central African Republic brief, 15 July 2026
World Bank RTFP Central African Republic, 41 markets, version 5 October 2026

safeguards: No WFP/FAO market price reclassified as farmgate.
No machine-learning estimate used without preserving source/method flags.
No secondary FAOSTAT production total converted into yield without matched harvested area.
Selected Admin 2 price coverage not assumed to cover all prefectures.
